description: 6 exemplars + 5 near-misses. Exemplars cover both entry paths — lettering (a wordmark image, an SVG wordmark, a hand-lettered raster) and a written brief — plus the German phrasing of the wordmark case. Near-misses are the neighbours that share the vocabulary and are somebody else's job: choosing or pairing an existing font (typography-system), building a type scale (typography-system), making a logo (logo-generation), tracing one icon or mark (svg-authoring), and an icon font from an existing set (iconography).

queries.q: turn our wordmark PNG into a full font — the rest of the alphabet in the same style
mach aus unserem Schriftzug eine komplette Schrift, mit Umlauten und ß
design an original display typeface for our brand from this brief: geometric, high contrast, flat terminals
I hand-lettered these six letters — can you extend them into a typeable font with woff2 output?
we have the logo as SVG; build a matching font so the team can set headlines in it
create a custom font file from scratch for our product, with kerning and a specimen page
pick a heading and body font pairing for our SaaS site
build a modular type scale with DTCG tokens
generate a logo for my bakery called Golden Crust
